reviews.comment:
Excelente servicio de este YPF BOXES. Vengo hace años y nunca modifico su calidad de atencion a los clientes. Te invitan un cafe mientras terminan de hacer los cambios en el auto, como el informe  siempre bien detallado, que te lo entregan en mano y tambien te lo envian x mail. Lastima que ahora no cambian filtros de polen ni de aire. La atencion siempre muy buena y personalizada.

(Translated by Google)
Excellent service at this YPF BOXES. I've been coming here for years and their customer service has never changed. They offer you a coffee while they finish working on your car, and the report is always very detailed, which they hand you in person and also send you by email. It's a shame they no longer change pollen or air filters. The service is always very good and personalized.
